title: NDE Alpine island
description: Configuration of one Alpine island. Mirrors the @NDEComponent options.

selector.description: The NDE host slot to hook into, e.g. nde-search-bar or nde-brief-result.

position.description: Where to render relative to the host component.

priority.description: Ordering when several components target the same slot. Lower renders first.

viewPattern.description: Regular expression (without slashes) matched against the vid. Omit to render in every view.

cspSafe.description: Fail `primo-alpine lint` when an expression would break under a strict CSP. Defaults to true for central islands, false for view islands.
